reviews.title: Good value processor with complete instruction set
reviews.comment: Basically the cheapest processor with AVX.  Good for AI applications that run 90% on GPU but use math libraries that need AVX support.
reviews.author: P. Mitchell

reviews.title: Learn to Read the reviews and understand what your buying
reviews.comment: What I dislike about is that it came with a cooler that I don't need because I already have a water cooled system, Other than that it's a great Processor for the money hands down. I see people giving bad reviews simply because they didn't read or understand the description of the product and it's not fair on the sellers part, before you buy make sure you fully understand if it will work for your needs and especially before you open it up. Amazon has wonderful return policy
reviews.author: kevin moan

reviews.title: I was between this and an i5.
reviews.comment: I was taken back by the price of this processor. Did a build on pcpartpicker, and saw this was $92. I wanted an i5 but due to demand right now it just seemed that an i5 was priced as an i7. I’ll eventually upgrade, but this thing plays Diablo 2 resurrected, Warzone, and some of my classics like Arma3 pretty well. For what it was, I didn’t expect much. It does better than I expected. No on board graphics though, but I had a GTX 1050 ti. Fresh build, and it installed windows fine, runs everything great.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.title: Open box
reviews.comment: Be warned that you may get an open box product with no indication anywhere on the listing. The Intel factory seal sticker was cut upon arrival. Box was also clearly handled, I didn't notice until I went to open the box. Product does work just fine as of writing this but who knows what will happen. The CPU cooler was without the pre-applied thermal paste which unless you have some can push your completed build a few days back. Although seller problems aside, it's a great value processer for less than $90. You can't beat the gaming or even desktop performance with anything in the same price bracket. Would highly recommend if you're on a tight budget.
reviews.author: Tyler G
